title: How does Arch protect against supply chain attacks
body: (concerning pacman safety) Hi. arch noob here, I've been experimenting and starting to rice (hoping this is the right terminology) my Arch setup but keep seeing things online about massive supply chain attacks where a repository owner is hacked or socially engineered so the stable or main branch of a given repository becomes backdoored or tampered with. I've legitimately enjoyed my experience thus far with Arch, but am concerned about such attacks and am wondering what Arch does to resist similar attacks. Is there something like a small holding period to see if there is obvious tampering with a package installed via pacman before it is released to the public? Is there something I can do to manually lower my risk? I've not touched the AUR yet for this reason. Thanks, xorsanitysanity
